channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israeli double-tap strike kills 15-year-old and paramedic in Gaza
item.description: A child has been killed in an Israeli double-tap strike as he rushed to help a paramedic wounded in an earlier attack.

item.title: At least five killed in Russian drone strike near Ukraine front line
item.description: At least seven people also injured in attack near Nikopol in southeastern Ukraine, Dnipropetrovsk governor says.

item.title: US House votes to end Iran war, 7 Republicans join in favour
item.description: For a third time, the US House approved a war powers resolution, halting Trump's ability to continue military action.

item.title: At least 20 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses
item.description: Dozens of people are missing beneath the rubble of the building in Gaza City, where some 10 families had been living.

item.title: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
item.description: The inspector also found a bottleneck in resupply, despite President Donald Trump's claims that US supplies are "virtually limitless".

item.title: Saudi Arabia says it shot down Houthi drone south of Mecca
item.description: The Houthis deny targeting the Islamic holy city after the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen accuses them of a "disgraceful act".

item.title: Journalist and pilot among three killed after news helicopter crashes in LA
item.description: The NBCLA news helicopter was flying near the scene of a fatal bus crash.

item.title: South African president vows justice as more women's bodies found near Johannesburg
item.description: Police have not linked the deaths to a serial killer but are investigating this possibility.

item.title: Philippines' Duterte seen in person for first time at International Criminal Court
item.description: He is due to be tried for crimes against humanity over thousands of deaths linked to his war on drugs.

item.title: Two sailors missing after tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz, Oman says
item.description: Iran says El Gaia caught fire after hitting mines, but the US says the oil tanker was struck by a missile and then a drone.
